messages.text: Happy to help with that. What's your order number? If you don't have it handy, the email or phone on the order works too.
Thanks. I just need one detail that matches the order to pull it up: the email on it, or the postcode ····to. Whichever you have.

Before I take it further, what's pushed you to cancel, the wait or something else? If it's the wait, I've got options that keep you better off than a refund.
the wait, I already ordered something else from you guys.
